title: Queen Apailana
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: As the elected ruler of Naboo at the end of the Clone Wars, Queen Apailana was the first to serve her planet - the home planet of Emperor Sheev Palpatine - during the reign of the Empire. She was present at the funeral for Padmé Amidala, the former Queen of Naboo, after her untimely death on Polis Massa.
